sun.awt

类 SunHints

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.awt.SunHints

  • public class SunHints
extends Object
    This class contains rendering hints that can be used by the Graphics2D class, and classes that implement BufferedImageOp and Raster.

    • 嵌套类概要

      嵌套类 
      限定符和类型 类和说明
      static class  SunHints.Key
      Defines the type of all keys used to control various aspects of the rendering and imaging pipelines.
      static class  SunHints.LCDContrastKey 
      static class  SunHints.Value
      Defines the type of all "enumerative" values used to control various aspects of the rendering and imaging pipelines.
